title: Raku Group Firing Event
bring: 2-3 bisque-fired pots, maximum 8 inches in any direction per piece
cost_text: $95 per person with 8-person minimum ($760 minimum group fee); includes instruction, supervision, basic raku glazes, kiln firings and fuel, firing materials, and same-day finished pieces
summary: A raku firing event for groups of 8-12 potters. Participants bring bisque-fired pots and fire them same-day, with no prior experience needed. Groups must reserve by emailing Clair@clayerco.com.
how_to_join: Email Clair@clayerco.com for availability, pricing, and reservations
source_quote: RAKU GROUP FIRING ABOUT: Who is this for? Perfect for pottery clubs, guilds, friends, team-building events, or anyone wanting to experience the excitement of raku firing together.
evidence_sentence: Groups of 8-12 potters can schedule a dedicated raku firing event, bringing bisque pots for glazing and same-day firing.
evidence_quote: The fee includes: Instruction and supervision Basic raku glazes Kiln firings and fuel All firing materials Same-day finished pieces
pay_text: $95 per person, 8-person minimum ($760 minimum group fee)
